conclusions.reason: Initialize changes Ready before initialized, but initialized ordering is a client requirement. Synchronous server may ignore dollar notifications; cancellation latency is project/responsiveness gap, not mandatory interrupt support. Non-null parent disappearance is should guidance, bundled client sends null.
conclusions.bound: No new blocking defect from these choices; retain project stale-cancellation promise separately.

conclusions.reason: Versions must increase at client; server admits equal/decreasing i32 versions. Public replacement proves robustness behavior, not a required rejection rule. Negative initial i32 is not itself an identified prohibition.
conclusions.bound: Do not count decreasing-version probe as valid-client protocol regression.

conclusions.reason: Public batched handle calls can preserve stale queue entries across close/reopen same URI+version and shutdown. Real stdio pumps after each input before next read. Reopened queue entries analyze current text twice; they do not emit old text.
conclusions.bound: Duplicate public work/source-comment mismatch is bounded; real burst coalescing/background cancellation has not been implemented or witnessed.

conclusions.reason: Server removes live document without publishing empty diagnostics. Official document gives a VSCode single-file clearing rule and server ownership; bundled client deletes locally.
conclusions.bound: Real wire close-clear gap deserves probe; no actual visible stale bundled UI claim, and no universal all-server close clearing MUST.

conclusions.reason: Static process catalog and one-file semantic analysis are real limits. No workspaceFolders/dynamic invalidation advertised. Reference capability is advertised and official feature describes project-wide lookup; current-document implementation remains explicitly bounded by project plan.
conclusions.bound: Record unsupported crossfile/per-root/live reload as desired capability gaps; do not assert these implemented from open SourceDb or trait crossURI fixtures, nor erase broad references promise merely because workspace capability absent.

conclusions.verdict: Agree source resource lead, narrow traversal
conclusions.reason: Append-only SourceDb retains distinct revisions and reopens; lint iterates all history before current-file filter. It reparses and runs syntax/lint rules per retained source using current CheckedProgram; it does not typecheck every historical source. Fresh Snapshot checks only requested file.
conclusions.bound: Source proves history-scaled work and retention, not measured RSS, crash, latency, or stale result leak; root measurements must use RealAnalysis.

conclusions.reason: References includeDeclaration is validated but not read/forwarded. Snapshot references include declaration plus uses. Official context boolean explicitly controls declaration inclusion. Extension forwards host includeDeclaration.
conclusions.bound: Root true/false same-symbol public/native probe requested; expected false omits declaration while source predicts identical arrays. This is distinct from invalid-client version robustness and unsupported crossfile graph.

conclusions.reason: Initialize capabilities are not stored. Rename/action always emit documentChanges. Bundled client does not advertise workspaceEdit.documentChanges or resourceOperations. Official WorkspaceEdit supports plain changes when neither capability is present; local converter accepting versioned changes masks this negotiated carrier mismatch.
conclusions.bound: Root absent/true documentChanges capability rename control requested. Source predicts same documentChanges output. No host application failure inferred; stale-version discard remains an independent client seam.
